question: How much did Nova (novaintelligence.com) raise in its latest funding announcement?

hits.title: This Week in SaaS - May 5 - 11, 2026.
hits.snippet: * Nova Intelligence (San Francisco-based agentic AI platform for SAP modernization; enterprise SaaS) - raised a $31.5M Series A on May 5, 2026; funds will support R&D and a major GTM expansion targeting Fortune 500 logos ahead of SAP's 2030 S/4HANA migration deadline (an estimated $89B services market).

hits.title: Kyndryl and Nova Intelligence announce strategic collaboration to accelerate SAP transformation for customers
hits.snippet: NEW YORK, August 5, 2025 - Kyndryl (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced a strategic collaboration with Nova Intelligence, a pioneer of multi-agent AI solutions for SAP Clean Core modernization, to accelerate AI-driven SAP digital transformation projects for customers.

accuracy.note: Answer states $31.5M Series A, not the gold $40 million

ar.note: Snippet 1 shows $31.5M Series A, not $40 million
